<center>
### Welcome! 
</center>

I am a postdoctoral researcher in the [Chaverri Lab](https://bowiestate.edu/academics/colleges/college-of-arts-and-sciences/departments/natural-sciences/research/labs/chaverri-research-lab/) at Bowie State University. I'm interested in the ecology and evolution of species interactions. My work is motivated by the critical need to conserve of biodiversity, with a focus on species that provide essential ecosystem services, such as pollinators and seed dispersers. On this site, you can find more information about my research and outreach activities.
